title: Warm Buttery Australian Broccoli Wrap
description: A delicious and healthy pescatarian-friendly dish featuring purple sprouting broccoli and ssam-wrap, perfect for a brunch mood, with a buttery and snappy texture.
instructions: Preheat a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the softened butter to the skillet and let it melt.
Add the minced garlic to the skillet and cook for 1 minute.
Add the trimmed purple sprouting broccoli to the skillet and cook for 3-4 minutes, or until tender.
Season the broccoli with salt and black pepper to taste.
Warm the ssam-wrap sheets by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20 seconds.
Assemble the wrap by placing a sheet of ssam-wrap on a flat surface, then adding a portion of the cooked broccoli, a sprinkle of grated cheddar cheese if using, and a squeeze of lemon juice.
Fold the bottom half of the ssam-wrap up over the filling, then fold in the sides and roll up the wrap to form a tight cylinder.
Serve the wraps warm and enjoy.
